title: CodeFlow FlowSpec (Fusion/Publish -> FlowView contract)
$comment: Tickets 02 + 12 target shape. E1 invariant: structural facts cannot be overwritten by E2/E3.
description: E1-OVERRIDES-BLOCKED INVARIANT (normative, design §3/§16 R2): steps originating as E1 structural evidence keep their structure cards forever. E2 (session) and E3 (approved) semantics may fill names/rules/state interpretations and outrank derived text by authority order approved > session > derived > unknown, but they can NEVER rewrite or delete an E1 structural step. When a semantic value's anchor no longer matches current code, that value flips freshness to 'stale' — the stale value is displayed but the structural card remains; only the approval queue resolves it. provenance (who made it) and freshness (currentness) are therefore separate REQUIRED fields on every step. basisSha (document-level) is the sha256 lowercase hex of the read-set fingerprint manifest captured before analysis; per-step basisSha pins the worktree state each step was fused against. unknowns[] MUST always be emitted (possibly empty): unresolvable blanks are preserved explicitly, never guessed away.

description.description: OPTIONAL 1-2 line human-readable summary of the business flow, shown in FlowView tabs. Derived from the entry symbol's doc comment (candidate intentSignals.docLine) when available, otherwise absent — consumers must degrade gracefully.

basisSha.description: sha256 lowercase hex of the read-set fingerprint; mismatch at publish => discard & re-analyze.

name.description: Rendered step name; authority-resolved text, never an E1 overwrite.

rules.description: Business rules shown in the 규칙 line.

branch.description: guard -> outcome rendering for branch steps.

kind.description: OPTIONAL structural kind carried over from the slice step so FlowView can label the step in natural language (조건 확인/상태 변경/기능 실행/흐름 분기). Presentation-only; never used for identity.

path.description: Repo-relative path. Lines are PRESENTATION-ONLY here: FlowView lens ranges are derived from the verified anchor at render time, never trusted for identity.

viewStartLine.description: OPTIONAL: first line of the symbol-scoped view (enclosing function body). FlowView defaults to this range so readers see the flow, not a lone line. Absent => view falls back to focus ± margin.

viewEndLine.description: OPTIONAL: last line of the symbol-scoped view. MUST be >= startLine when present (producer-enforced).

codeLens.description: focus = [startLine, endLine] (the step's exact evidence lines); view = [viewStartLine, viewEndLine] (the enclosing symbol body, presentation-only, derived from the anchor's symbolRange at render time).

unknowns.description: Explicitly preserved unknowns (design principle #3). Empty array allowed; field itself mandatory so producers must decide.

subject.description: What could not be determined (symbol path / question).

edges.description: OPTIONAL call/delegation edges between steps and their targets, carried over from the slice so FlowView can show where a step hands work off to. Presentation-only; identity never depends on it. Absent in older published specs — consumers must degrade gracefully.

stepOrdinal.description: 1-based ordinal of the step that produces this edge. Absent in older payloads — consumers must not guess.

truncated.description: OPTIONAL: true when slice traversal stopped early (depth cap or cycle). FlowView must surface this honestly — the reader is seeing part of the flow, not all of it.
